name: CommandPalette
purpose: Offers a searchable command list (⌘K pattern) with a reproducible default sort.
scenarios: Jump to a command from the keyboard
Run a palette command and dismiss the overlay

open.description: Whether the palette overlay is shown.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the overlay should open or close.

commands.description: Command entries with value, label, optional shortcut and group.

onQueryChange.description: Called when the filter query changes.

onSelect.description: Called with the command value when a command is run.

label.description: Accessible name of the dialog and search field.

emptyLabel.description: Copy shown when the filter matches nothing.

closeLabel.description: Accessible name of the dismiss control.

states.name: open
states.description: Palette is shown with an empty query.

states.name: filtered
states.description: Palette is shown with a non-empty query.

antiPatterns: Do not randomize command order; default sort must be localeCompare en on label then value.
Do not trap the user without Escape or a labelled close control.

keyboard: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the active option
a11y.focus: The search field is a combobox; options are in a listbox with aria-activedescendant.
a11y.labeling: Dialog and field share the accessible name; close has an aria-label.

responsive.strategy: Positioner is the query container. Compact is a bottom sheet; tablet/desktop center a constrained dialog. No viewport size media.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
